Our Story

A small brand with a big dream.

ICONIC CO began with two friends and a simple idea — bring back the real taste of traditional Indian masalas. After months of work, they launched in August 2026 with their first two products, blessed at the temple and packed by hand.

The journey has only just started — and every order takes the dream one step further.

🎯 Our goal: grow ICONIC CO into a ₹10 lakh company by 1 January 2027 — one kitchen at a time.
